subject_specific_evidence.lab_subject_1:P4: Worst channel in all 93 epochs above 1000 uV peak-to-peak; failure concentrated in the final two condition windows.
subject_specific_evidence.lab_subject_9:P4: Worst channel in 8 of 10 epochs above 750 uV peak-to-peak; contamination includes five of seven baseline epochs and the third condition window.
subject_specific_evidence.lab_subject_10:C4: Worst channel in 258 of 264 epochs above 1000 uV peak-to-peak; failure persists across the final three condition windows.

interpolation.description: Spherical spline interpolation for EEG channels.

ica.reason: Mandatory no-ICA sensitivity after 2026-08-19 human approval of ICA as primary. Same notch, 0.5-40 Hz, average reference, interpolation, and frozen_v3 1050 uV epoch rule as the ICA primary branch.

epoch_rejection.reason: Primary threshold selected as 1050 uV after observing subject 14's 1042.56 uV no-ad post epoch. This participant-retention-driven, post-review choice retains that pair while rejecting more of the gross-artifact tail than frozen_v2 at 1500 uV. Both 1000 uV frozen_v1 and 1500 uV frozen_v2 remain mandatory sensitivity policies.
